INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( NOTIFICATION_ID, USER_ID, SENDER_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CD, TITLE, CONTENT, READ_YN, REG_DT, USE_YN ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{userId}, #{senderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{targetType}, #{targetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{notificationTypeCd}, #{title}, #{content}, 'N', SYSDATE, 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTIFICATION_ID, n.USER_ID, n.SENDER_ID, u.NAME AS SENDER_NAME, n.TARGET_TYPE, targetCd.DTL_CD_NM AS TARGET_TYPE_NM, n.TARGET_ID, n.NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CD, typeCd.DTL_CD_NM AS NOTIFICATION_TYPE_NM, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.READ_YN, TO_CHAR(n.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT, TO_CHAR(n.READ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS READ_DT FROM NOTIFICATION n LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = n.SENDER_ID LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE_DTL typeCd ON typeCd.COM_CD_ID = 'NOTIFICATION_TYPE' AND typeCd.DTL_CD_ID = n.NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE_DTL targetCd ON targetCd.COM_CD_ID = 'TARGET_TYPE' AND targetCd.DTL_CD_ID = n.TARGET_TYPE WHERE n.USER_ID = #{userId} AND n.USE_YN = 'Y' AND n.REG_DT >= SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY n.REG_DT DESC
